description: A page's revisions in the AcuiQ reference wiki, newest first: each one's `id`, version, change type, message, date and the blocks it changed. Address the page as get_page does. A revision `id` is what a restore takes, where this server has one. Defaults: limit 20 (max 100).

path.description: The page's whole path, e.g. "developers/scrypto/blueprints". Preferred over tagPath + slug.

slug.description: Page slug. Ignored when `path` is set.

tagPath.description: Tag path only ("" for a top-level page). Ignored when `path` is set.

name: get_page_history
title: Page history
